content:
Track: SQL Foundations
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
   - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
   - Lesson 3: Filtering Data with WHERE Clause
   - Lesson 4: Sorting and Limiting Data with ORDER BY and LIMIT Clauses
   - Lesson 5: JOIN Operations (Inner, Outer, Left Outer, Right Outer)
   - Lesson 6: Subqueries
   - Lesson 7: Understanding NULL Values and IS NULL Operator
   - Lesson 8: Aggregations with COUNT(), SUM(), AVG(), MAX(), MIN()
   - Lesson 9: GROUP BY Clause for Organizing Data
   - Lesson 10: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses (Advanced)

   Track: Data Cleaning with Pandas
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Pandas Library in Python
   - Lesson 2: Reading and Writing Data with Pandas
   - Lesson 3: Basic Data Manipulation: Indexing, Slicing, and Assignment
   - Lesson 4: Handling Missing Values using fillna() and dropna() functions
   - Lesson 5: Merging and Concatenating DataFrames
   - Lesson 6: Data Filtering with Boolean Operations
   - Lesson 7: Data Aggregation and Grouping with groupby() function
   - Lesson 8: Reshaping Data (Melting, Pivoting)
   - Lesson 9: Handling Time Series Data with Pandas Timestamp
   - Lesson 10: Introduction to Regular Expressions for Data Cleaning (Optional)

   Track: Data Visualization with Matplotlib
   - Lesson 1: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts
   - Lesson 2: Creating Bar Plots, Histograms, and Box Plots
   - Lesson 3: Scatter Plots and Heatmaps
   - Lesson 4: Area Plots and Stacked Bar Plots
   - Lesson 5: Customizing Plot Elements (Colors, Labels, Titles)
   - Lesson 6: Using Log Scales and Multi-axis Plots
   - Lesson 7: Saving and Importing Matplotlib Figures
   - Lesson 8: Annotating Plots with Text and Images
   - Lesson 9: Creating Interactive Plots (Optional)
   - Lesson 10: Building Dynamic Visualizations with Functions (Optional)

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
   - Lesson 1: Importing, Inspecting, and Summarizing Data
   - Lesson 2: Creating Descriptive Statistics Plots (Mean, Median, Mode)
   - Lesson 3: Correlation Matrix and Heatmaps
   - Lesson 4: Visualizing Categorical Data with Pie Charts and Count Plots
   - Lesson 5: Distributions and Statistical Tests (Normality, Outliers)
   - Lesson 6: Creating Scatter Plots Matrix for Exploring Relationships
   - Lesson 7: Time Series Analysis using Line Plots and Autocorrelation Functions
   - Lesson 8: Introduction to Clustering and Anomaly Detection Techniques (Optional)
   - Lesson 9: Data Sampling Techniques (Stratified, Bootstrap, etc.) (Optional)
   - Lesson 10: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals (Optional)

   Track: Working with APIs
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to RESTful APIs
   - Lesson 2: Making GET Requests using Python
   - Lesson 3: Parsing JSON Data from API Responses
   - Lesson 4: Sending POST and PUT Requests (Optional)
   - Lesson 5: Handling Authentication with APIs (Basic Auth, OAuth, etc.) (Optional)
   - Lesson 6: Caching API Calls for Performance Improvement (Optional)
   - Lesson 7: Error Handling and Retrying API Requests (Optional)
   - Lesson 8: Scraping Web Pages with BeautifulSoup (Optional)
   - Lesson 9: Introduction to Data Streaming APIs (Real-time data, SSE) (Optional)
   - Lesson 10: Building a Simple API using Flask (Optional)

   Track: SQL for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Advanced JOIN Operations (Cross, Natural, and Self Join)
   - Lesson 2: Using CASE expressions in SELECT statements
   - Lesson 3: Creating User-defined Functions and Aggregates
   - Lesson 4: Working with Date and Time Data Types
   - Lesson 5: Window Functions (RANK, ROW_NUMBER, LAG)
   - Lesson 6: Using Subqueries for Advanced Analysis
   - Lesson 7: Creating Temporary and Permanent Tables
   - Lesson 8: Optimizing SQL Queries with Indexes
   - Lesson 9: Writing Efficient and Readable SQL Code (Best Practices)
   - Lesson 10: Advanced Topics in Databases (Triggers, Views, Stored Procedures) (Optional)
